name: dense_qkv_prefill_causal_h8_kv1or8_d128
description: Dense Q/K/V causal prefill attention (forward only) with q_heads=8, kv_heads in {8,1}, head_dim=128 Layout: [B, S, H, D].

num_kv_heads.description: KV heads for dense prefill; must be 8 (MHA) or 1 (GQA-style shared KV).

seq_len.description: Sequence length for prefill. q/k/v share the same sequence length.

reference:
import torch


@torch.no_grad()
def run(q, k, v, sm_scale):
    # AITER-style main path only (branches removed):
    # causal=True, dropout=0, no padding/window/alibi.
    # input/output layout for this task: [B, S, H, D]
    assert q.ndim == 4 and k.ndim == 4 and v.ndim == 4
    bq, sq, hq, dq = q.shape
    bk, sk, hk, dk = k.shape
    bv, sv, hv, dv = v.shape

    assert (bq, sq, dq) == (bk, sk, dk) == (bv, sv, dv)
    assert hq == 8
    assert hk in (1, 8)
    assert hv == hk
    assert dq == 128

    if hk != hq:
        groups = hq // hk
        k = k.repeat_interleave(groups, dim=2)
        v = v.repeat_interleave(groups, dim=2)

    qf = q.to(torch.float32)
    kf = k.to(torch.float32)
    vf = v.to(torch.float32)

    scores = torch.einsum("bthd,bshd->bhts", qf * float(sm_scale), kf)
    causal_mask = torch.triu(
        torch.ones((sq, sk), device=q.device, dtype=torch.bool),
        diagonal=1,
    )
    scores = scores.masked_fill(causal_mask.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0), float("-inf"))
    probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    out = torch.einsum("bhts,bshd->bthd", probs, vf)
    return out.to(torch.bfloat16)
